purpose: Renew one weak-subjectivity checkpoint anchor from the first to the latest checkpoint authenticated by the exact same bounded three-hop OrderTrustPathV1.

imports.trust_path_requirement: exactly three verified hops; first checkpoint comes from ExistingFreshGenesisTransition and renewed checkpoint comes from the final CheckpointAnchoredTransition

verified_relations: The first and last checkpoint used by renewal are carried by the exact same verified three-hop trust path.
The supplied OrderTrustPathV1 is independently strict-decoded, byte-for-byte re-encoded and fully verified before renewal semantics are evaluated.
The prior anchor is derived field-for-field from the exact EpochCheckpointV1 carried by hop zero, including context, epoch, height, block, validator set, parameters and both state roots.

The renewed anchor is derived field-for-field from the exact EpochCheckpointV1 carried by the final checkpoint-anchored hop; current-epoch authority cannot be substituted for checkpoint-epoch authority.
The terminal trusted state equals the final hop output bytes and its latest_checkpoint_id equals the renewed checkpoint id.
Chain id, genesis hash and protocol version preserve lineage; stack profile changes remain committed by the checkpoint contexts.
Observed finalized epoch and height equal the terminal trusted state's finalized head, not its later certified head.
The prior checkpoint remains inside both committed epoch-age and block-age windows at the observed finalized head; the renewed checkpoint is strictly later in epoch and height.
Renewal meets the committed minimum finalized-height advance, rejects rollback, and rejects a different checkpoint id or block id at the same height.
All anchor, policy and renewal identifiers are recomputed with length-prefixed DigestV1 domains.
explicit_exclusions: No wall-clock oracle, operator key, governance authorization or external bootstrap-package authentication.
No renewal from an arbitrary checkpoint not already authenticated by this exact bounded TrustPath.
No more than three trust-path hops, arbitrary-length iteration or unbounded weak-subjectivity history.
No v0 activation authority, migration verification, state sync or non-Order proof class.
No complete wire or crypto corpus, second implementation or interoperability claim.
No global light-client completeness, normative freeze, node implementation, production activation or release-readiness claim.
